title: Lampada: Prayer Journal
shortDescription: Prayer as a living conversation: gentle questions, Bible passages, a journal.
fullDescription:
Lampada is an app for personal prayer. It doesn't pray for you or hand you ready-made answers: it helps you pause, focus, and hear the quiet voice within.

HOW IT WORKS
• Name your topic in your own words — for example, gratitude for the day, a worry, a hard decision, or prayer for your family.
• AI asks gentle questions. Each one builds on your previous answer, so prayer becomes a living conversation rather than a list of requests.
• Answer by text or voice — or simply reflect in silence. Recording answers is optional, and you can skip any question.
• Along the way, Lampada picks Bible passages that fit the meaning of your prayer. You can read them or listen to them.
• At the end comes a closing question: what do you want to carry from this prayer into your day?

JOURNAL
Your answers and takeaways are saved in a journal. Come back to them in a week or a year and see how God has been leading you. Save Bible passages that speak to you to your favorites. The home screen shows your last seven days — a quiet reminder to return to prayer, with no streaks to lose.

QUIET AND FOCUS
• A prayer timer and calm background music.
• Prayer reminders on the days and at the times that suit you.
• Several Bible translations and audio narration of Scripture.

WHAT'S PERSONAL STAYS PERSONAL
• Your journal is stored on your device.
• Protect the app with a PIN, fingerprint, or face unlock.
• Your topic and answers are sent to tailor the questions only with your consent, which you can withdraw in Settings. Without consent the app still works; the questions are just more general.
